content.text: I found no known issues, recent paste-handling changes, or workarounds for t002. Searches for "paste table Google Sheets columns" and "paste Chrome 131" returned only t002 itself, plus unrelated tickets: t021 (a login problem) and t058 (an urgent outage where notebooks show a blank screen and sessions expire, which doesn't match the paste symptom). The ticket records only the bug category, normal priority, and the reported "worked fine last week" timeline, and I have no access to a changelog or release notes to check for recent changes.
